title: WCAG 2.2 AA technical audit: DDI & AI skills and capabilities framework

method.automated: axe-core 4.13.0 in Playwright Chromium, WCAG 2 A/AA, 2.1 A/AA and 2.2 AA tags, plus best-practice rules
method.manual: Structured review of WCAG 2.2 AA, including 2.2-only criteria, landmarks, forms, no-JavaScript, reflow at 320px, and colour contrast
not_included: Screen reader user testing (NVDA, VoiceOver, JAWS)
Formal 200% zoom sign-off with assistive technology users

products.name: Framework publication and data downloads
products.notes: HTML guides and CSV/JSON downloads. Content is readable without JavaScript. Skip link, menu and help links are in the HTML. Signed off on this technical audit; not yet user-tested with assistive technology.

products.name: Self-assessment prototype
products.notes: JavaScript prototype, not a live government service. You cannot start or continue an assessment without JavaScript. Out of scope for the publication accessibility statement.

contrast.note: Not used as the only indicator for a control. Form inputs use 2px #0b0c0c.

findings.summary: Intake validation wrote errors to a hidden element
findings.detail: Errors now show in a role=alert on the form, mark aria-invalid, and focus the first invalid field.

findings.summary: Loading and error status were not announced
findings.detail: Boot, report and chat status use aria-live polite or role=alert.

findings.summary: Pages used a div instead of main, and skip/help were JavaScript-only
findings.detail: Publication pages now use main, a skip link, and a noscript menu with accessibility, privacy and contact links.

findings.summary: Skip to content included the assessment sidebar
findings.detail: Skip target moves with the view: list, intake, or main pane.

findings.summary: The assessment cannot be completed without JavaScript
findings.detail: A noscript message explains this and links to the HTML framework. Starting an assessment still needs JavaScript. This is why the prototype is not signed off.

findings.summary: Organisation and role inputs lacked autocomplete
findings.detail: Fields now use autocomplete name, organization-title and organization.
Intake and profile state that fields are required. Hints are tied with aria-describedby.

findings.summary: Radar chart had no text alternative for the scores
findings.detail: Chart is decorative. Broader skill levels are listed as text next to it.

findings.summary: Contact was a placeholder, so consistent help was incomplete
findings.detail: Contact is training@theodi.org on publication and prototype contact pages.

findings.summary: Some navigation targets were under 24px tall
findings.detail: Service navigation links and the Menu control now have a minimum 24px hit area (Menu 44px).

findings.summary: Sticky wizard footer may obscure a focused field
findings.detail: Extra padding exists on the scroll area. Not retested with every keyboard path. Does not affect the signed-off publication.

findings.summary: Card and table borders use mid-grey at 2.08:1
findings.detail: Decorative only. Inputs use 2px black borders. Accepted for the publication sign-off.
